enemies.name: chomper
enemies.description: Melee. Chases the player and deals 1 contact damage. No ranged attack. Worth 100 points.

enemies.name: smice
enemies.description: Ranged. Drifts slowly left across the screen. Every 1.8 s it winds up for 0.35 s, then fires 1 projectile aimed at the player (damage 1, speed 220, radius 7, lives 8 s). 1 contact damage. Worth 150 points.

enemies.name: pigice
enemies.description: Area. Drifts slowly left. Every 3.2 s it telegraphs for 0.8 s, then releases an expanding ring (radius 110, lasts 0.4 s, damage 1). 1 contact damage. Worth 250 points.

enemies.name: theice
enemies.description: Boss. Stays still on the right of the screen. Alternates two attacks: a beam sweeping left (every 8 s, 1.3 s telegraph, damage 2, width 96, lasts 1.8 s) and a burst of 12 projectiles in all directions (every 4.5 s, 0.8 s telegraph, damage 1, speed 170, radius 24). Below 50% HP it enrages: attack intervals x0.75 and projectiles 10% faster. 2 contact damage. Worth 2500 points.

enemies.name: gummyworm
enemies.description: Area. Drifts slowly left. Every 2.8 s it telegraphs for 0.9 s, then releases an expanding ring (radius 140, lasts 0.4 s, damage 1). 1 contact damage. Worth 375 points.

enemies.name: candybear
enemies.description: Boss. Stays still on the right of the screen. Every 3.4 s, after a 1.1 s telegraph, it fires a fan of 3 projectiles aimed at the player over a 36 degree spread (damage 2, speed 230, radius 36, lives 8 s). Below 50% HP it enrages: intervals x0.7 and projectiles 15% faster. 2 contact damage. Worth 4000 points.

enemies.name: denturesk

enemies.name: carry
enemies.description: Boss. Patrols up and down on the right of the screen (between y=140 and y=580). Every 2.8 s, after a 1.2 s telegraph, it fires 1 aimed projectile that kills instantly (damage 9999, speed 360, radius 14, single shot). Below 40% HP it enrages: intervals x0.65, projectiles 15% faster, and it fires 3 projectiles over a 30 degree spread. 2 contact damage. Worth 10000 points.
